verdicts.quote: “Squarespace uses OAuth 2.0 to authorize third-party applications to integrate with Squarespace and consume Squarespace APIs.”
verdicts.reason: OAuth2 is the vendor’s public client auth for third‑party apps; suitable for multi‑tenant access. ([commerce-apis.squarespace.com](https://commerce-apis.squarespace.com/oauth))

verdicts.quote: “Before a client can make Squarespace API calls, the client must be registered… Submit… via this form… We will review your registration and respond with your_client_id and your_client_secret…”
verdicts.reason: OAuth client credentials require submitting a form and passing Squarespace’s review, i.e., app_review. ([commerce-apis.squarespace.com](https://commerce-apis.squarespace.com/oauth))

verdicts.quote: “Contacts API… Discounts API… Inventory API… Orders API… Products API… Transactions API… Webhook Subscriptions API.”
verdicts.reason: Multiple commerce resources with reads/writes and webhooks, but focused on commerce (not full site CMS), so moderate. ([commerce-apis.squarespace.com](https://commerce-apis.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/overview?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: “The Squarespace MCP server connects AI assistants to Squarespace… Your MCP client connects directly to: https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp”
verdicts.reason: Official vendor page documents an official Squarespace MCP server and endpoint. ([developers.squarespace.com](https://developers.squarespace.com/mcp/overview))

verdicts.quote: “We will review your registration and respond with your_client_id and your_client_secret…”
verdicts.reason: Buildable now with docs and endpoints, but caveats include OAuth app review and plan‑gated APIs (e.g., Orders/Inventory availability by plan). ([commerce-apis.squarespace.com](https://commerce-apis.squarespace.com/oauth))
